title: Free Subtitle & Caption Tools
metaDescription: Free subtitle tools that run in your browser: convert subtitle files without uploading them anywhere and without creating an account.
intro: Small tools for subtitle files, free and without an account. They run in your browser, so your files never leave your device.

faq.question: Are these tools really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There's no sign-up and no limit on how many files you convert.

faq.question: Are my files uploaded?
faq.answer: No. The conversion runs in your browser. The file is read on your device and the result is created there too.

faq.question: Can Supertitle burn subtitles into my video?
faq.answer: Yes, from the video itself: Supertitle transcribes the speech, lets you fix the text and exports an MP4 with the captions burned in. It doesn't import subtitle files.
